name: Inquisitive
description: A legacy rogue subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Ear for Deceit
grants.description: When making an Insight check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.

grants.name: Eye for Detail
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, make a Perception check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Investigation check to uncover or interpret clues.

grants.name: Insightful Fighting
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, make an Insight check contested by a visible creature's Deception. On success, use Sneak Attack against it without advantage for 1 minute, unless you have disadvantage. The effect ends early if used on another target.

grants.name: Steady Eye
grants.description: Gain advantage on Perception and Investigation checks if you move no more than half your Speed on the same turn.

grants.name: Unerring Eye
grants.description: As an action while not Blinded or Deafened, sense the presence—but not the nature—of illusions, shapechangers, and magic designed to deceive the senses within 30 feet. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1, restored on a Long Rest.

grants.name: Eye for Weakness
grants.description: Sneak Attack deals an extra 3d6 damage against the creature currently affected by your Insightful Fighting.
